description: Settings endpoints (GET/PUT /api/v1/settings, POST /api/v1/settings/reset) in api/internal/handlers/settings.go. Trigger threshold endpoints (PUT /api/v1/investigations/triggers/{id}/threshold). Default thresholds: CPU 70/90, Memory 80/95, Disk 85/95, TCP 500/1000.

requirements.description: System must provide API endpoints to configure warning and critical thresholds for all monitored metrics
requirements.title: Configurable Alert Thresholds

title: Configurable warning/critical thresholds (via API settings endpoints)
